upstream.note: Public JSON feed. Only factual patch metadata is mirrored; every row deep-links the relevant CVE page.

patches.title: Drupal attackers take over sites via installer without login
patches.who: Anyone running an unpatched Drupal core site (Drupal 8-11) with the installer reachable, especially on end-of-life branches
patches.fix: Upgrade to Drupal 11.4.14, 11.3.23 or 10.6.23, run update.php, and block /core/install.php

patches.title: VMware vCenter attackers bypass login and take admin control
patches.who: Anyone running an unpatched VMware vCenter Server 7.0, 8.0, 9.0 or 9.1, including Cloud Foundation and Telco builds, reachable over the network
patches.fix: Patch to vCenter 9.1.1.0200, 9.0.2.0200 or 8.0 U3m; no workaround, 7.0 needs Broadcom support

patches.key: hewlett packard enterprise (hpe)|juniper session smart conductor
patches.product: Juniper Session Smart Conductor and Session Smart Router
patches.title: Juniper Session Smart attackers run commands as root remotely
patches.who: Anyone running HPE Juniper Session Smart Conductor or Session Smart Router software before fixed releases, especially if internet-reachable
patches.fix: Upgrade to 7.0.5, 7.1.7, or 7.2.3 or later; Juniper lists no workaround

patches.title: MONAI Label attackers write files anywhere, leading to root code execution
patches.who: Anyone running a MONAI Label server version 0.8.5 or older, especially with authentication off (the default) and reachable from untrusted networks.
patches.fix: Upgrade to MONAI Label 0.8.8 (pip install -U monailabel==0.8.8); meanwhile keep servers off untrusted networks and enable authentication.

patches.title: Xen Orchestra attackers can log in as admin without credentials
patches.who: Anyone running a network-reachable Xen Orchestra server (xo-server 5.7.4 and earlier, or Xen Orchestra before 6.9.2 and 6.10.1)
patches.fix: Upgrade to Xen Orchestra 6.9.2 or 6.10.1, or xo-server 5.211.2 or 5.213.1.

patches.title: Idunno.AntiCsrf lets attackers run code on servers with one web request
patches.who: Anyone running an old ASP.NET WebForms site that loads the Idunno.AntiCsrf module, especially internet-facing applications with anonymous pages
patches.fix: No patch exists; remove Idunno.AntiCsrf from Web.config and bin, then replace it with ASP.NET's built-in AntiForgery

patches.title: Cisco Expressway lets attackers run commands as root
patches.who: Anyone running clustered Cisco Expressway-C or Expressway-E gateways on X15.5.3 or earlier, or any X14 or earlier release
patches.fix: Upgrade clustered devices to X15.5.20 or later; X14 and earlier must migrate to a fixed release

patches.title: Mitel MiCollab flaw lets attackers run commands on server
patches.who: Anyone running Mitel MiCollab 10.3 (10.3.0.18) or earlier with the AWV conferencing component reachable from the internet
patches.fix: Upgrade to 10.3 (10.3.0.18) and apply patch KB000129195, or move to a later release

patches.title: Danfoss AK-SM 800A attackers bypass login and read sensitive data
patches.who: Anyone running a Danfoss AK-SM 8xxA Series controller prior to version 4.2, especially internet-exposed units
patches.fix: Install firmware 4.2 or later from Danfoss's AK-SM 800A download page; no mitigation provided

patches.title: Optimizely Web Experimentation lets attackers inject malicious scripts into websites
patches.who: Visitors to sites using Optimizely Web Experimentation before 2026-11-17, and customers whose projects were changed
patches.fix: No customer patch; Optimizely fixed it on 16 November. Confirm project impact with Optimizely and review affected pages.

patches.title: MailAssure server probes and attacks internal network systems
patches.who: Anyone running a self-hosted N-able MailAssure or SpamExperts Local Cloud server before build 20261121.1943, and any holder of high-privilege API credentials for these services.
patches.fix: Update to build 20261121.1943 or later; rotate API and OAuth tokens, and restrict outbound traffic.

patches.title: SAP NetWeaver Portal lets attackers redirect lookups, exposing or altering server data
patches.who: Anyone running SAP NetWeaver Enterprise Portal 7.50 (EP-BASIS or EP-RUNTIME), especially if reachable from untrusted networks
patches.fix: Apply SAP Security Note 3660969 (November 2025 patch); restrict portal network access until applied

patches.title: Apache Roller attackers can run code on server without logging in
patches.who: Anyone running Apache Roller 4.0.0 through 6.1.5 with its XML-RPC endpoint reachable over the network
patches.fix: Upgrade to Roller 6.1.7 (6.1.6 minimum); or set enabledForExtensions to false in web.xml and restart

patches.title: Synology DSM attackers can run code remotely, no login needed
patches.who: Anyone running a Synology NAS with DSM or BeeStation OS below the fixed builds, especially if reachable from the internet or QuickConnect
